title: Every Reason Chimpanzees Kill Their Own Relatives, Including Doug
alt_titles: Every Reason the Chimpanzee Is the Scariest Ape Alive

thumbnail_brief: One adult male chimpanzee, hair on end, holding a stick bitten to a point and staring straight out of a dark forest, with tiny Doug in a chimp costume (red cap on top) looking up at it and the label HE'S FAMILY, so the title gives the killing and the thumbnail says Doug is next of kin (no RELATIVES, KILL, DOUG or CHIMP on the image).
description:
Why do chimpanzees kill their own relatives? Doug climbs the chimpanzee family tree, from the bushbabies chimps hunt with spears they sharpen with their teeth to the gorillas, the humans, the bonobos and finally the chimps' own former groupmates, and each step closer is more dangerous than the last.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
